related.title: Wi-Fi 6E：6 GHz 與5 GHz的傳播比較
related.titleEn: Wi-Fi6E: comparing6 GHz and5 GHz propagation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 4.19 mA 與 0.998 mA，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 4.19 mA and 0.998 mA, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1.58362492095 dB additional loss與7.95880017344 dB additional loss，建立wifi6e_pathloss.csv、波長對照、環境/法規待查項，並完成以下驗收：原餘裕5 dB時6相對2.4的理想差已超過預算；不可保證穿牆覆蓋或任意國家可用頻段。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1.58362492095 dB additional loss and 7.95880017344 dB additional loss; create wifi6e_pathloss.csv, wavelength checks and environment/regulation questions; apply this acceptance decision: A5 dB original margin cannot absorb the ideal6-versus2.4 difference; do not promise wall coverage or spectrum availability in every country.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 TWT協調喚醒窗口；平均電流由活躍及睡眠時間加權，還要計喚醒成本與錯過預約的重試。 展開基準式 80*0.05+0.2*0.95；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐狀態積分mA*ms再除週期；追加每次喚醒耗電欄，避免把量測尖峰刪掉。 將兩條推導一起存入 twt_current.csv、服務窗口、待傳資料量。
從原理 固定距離與天線增益的自由空間損耗差為20log10(f2/f1)；不把頻率差誤當法定發射功率差。 展開基準式 20*log10(6/5)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用波長平方比例反算，並在圖上明確標同距離；實際法規與設備模式另查當地規定。 將兩條推導一起存入 wifi6e_pathloss.csv、波長對照、環境/法規待查項。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from TWT coordinates wake windows; average current is time-weighted active/sleep current plus wake overhead and missed-slot retries., expand baseline expression 80*0.05+0.2*0.95; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Integrate mA*ms by state and divide by cycle; add a wake-charge column rather than deleting measured spikes. Save both derivations with twt_current.csv, service windows and queued-data volumes.

Starting from At equal distance and antenna gains, free-space loss difference is20log10(f2/f1); this is not a difference in legally permitted transmit power., expand baseline expression 20*log10(6/5); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Cross-check with wavelength-squared ratios and mark equal distance; actual regulations and device modes require local verification. Save both derivations with wifi6e_pathloss.csv, wavelength checks and environment/regulation questions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IEEE 802.15.4 CSMA：隨機退避與競爭窗口
related.titleEn: IEEE802.15.4 CSMA: random backoff and contention window
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 4.19 mA 與 0.998 mA，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 4.19 mA and 0.998 mA, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1120 microsecond與4960 microsecond，建立csma_backoff.csv、CCA結果、平均/最大等待，並完成以下驗收：3 ms平均退避預算僅BE3符合，但不能據此要求在擁擠媒介永遠使用小窗口。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1120 microsecond and 4960 microsecond; create csma_backoff.csv, CCA outcomes and mean/max waiting; apply this acceptance decision: OnlyBE3 fits a3 ms mean-backoff budget; that does not justify always using a small window in congestion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 TWT協調喚醒窗口；平均電流由活躍及睡眠時間加權，還要計喚醒成本與錯過預約的重試。 展開基準式 80*0.05+0.2*0.95；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐狀態積分mA*ms再除週期；追加每次喚醒耗電欄，避免把量測尖峰刪掉。 將兩條推導一起存入 twt_current.csv、服務窗口、待傳資料量。
從原理 均勻退避整數0至2^BE-1的平均為(2^BE-1)/2；只估等待，未加入CCA、碰撞與重試。 展開基準式 (2**3-1)/2*320；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：枚舉0..7及0..31，再用首末平均交叉驗證；分清平均等待與最大等待。 將兩條推導一起存入 csma_backoff.csv、CCA結果、平均/最大等待。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from TWT coordinates wake windows; average current is time-weighted active/sleep current plus wake overhead and missed-slot retries., expand baseline expression 80*0.05+0.2*0.95; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Integrate mA*ms by state and divide by cycle; add a wake-charge column rather than deleting measured spikes. Save both derivations with twt_current.csv, service windows and queued-data volumes.

Starting from Uniform integer backoff0 through2^BE-1 has mean(2^BE-1)/2; this estimates waiting before CCA, collisions and retries., expand baseline expression (2**3-1)/2*320; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Enumerate0..7 and0..31 and cross-check with endpoint means; distinguish mean from maximum waiting. Save both derivations with csma_backoff.csv, CCA outcomes and mean/max waiting.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
